purpose: Illustrative research scenarios, NOT vendor quotes, flight-certified equipment or independent BCG replication

provenance.gpu_tdp_w: NVIDIA H200 SXM official up to 700W: https://www.nvidia.com/en-in/data-center/h200/
provenance.orbital_mass_design: R1 physical model; NASA solar ROSA 100 W/kg and BCG radiator 400m2/100kW are limited proxy anchors
provenance.gpu_prices_orbit_build_and_ops: ALL FINANCIAL COMPONENT UNIT PRICES ARE EXPLICIT ANALYST WHAT-IF ASSUMPTIONS, NOT OBSERVED PURCHASE PRICES
provenance.ground_prices: ALL ANALYST WHAT-IF ASSUMPTIONS, NOT BCG 20-year TCO decomposition; results cannot be compared as calibrated peer benchmarks
provenance.failure_rates: ANNUAL partial IT replacement fraction versus annual whole-module loss probability; NOT BCG's unspecified 5/10/20/30 percent failure rate parameter
provenance.transport: Proportional cost-per-delivered-kg what-if only; no integer-per-launch pricing, target orbit, annual launch capacity, volume or physical assembly schedule
provenance.limitations: Whole-module loss stress uses additive expectation, not stochastic renewal/survival dynamics; it can double-count periodic replacement and is an upper-bound stress illustration
